name: ds-utils-xai
description: Explainable AI (XAI) and model interpretation for tree-based models. Use for plotting feature importance rankings, rendering Graphviz decision tree diagrams, and exporting decision rules as text. Do NOT use for linear models, neural network interpretability, or clustering.
